It found that the credit reporting company received 360,000 Hong Kong nationals and supervised Shen Boyang, prosecuted them for violating the Personal Data Protection Law, and issued a warrant for the suspected owner of Hong Kong in China. In this regard, Ma Yuwen, a candidate for the Democratic Progressive Party's Taipei City Council, criticized the Blue Committee for its addiction to rollover, and regarded National Security as a joke, shameful and ugly.
